description_en: Associates a whitelist template with an instance
description_zh: 该接口用于将白名单模板关联到实例
kebab_example: aliyun rds attach-whitelist-template-to-instance --template-id 412 --ins-name rm-bp191w771kd30000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachWhitelistTemplateToInstance

parameters.help_en: The ID of the whitelist template. You can call the DescribeAllWhitelistTemplate operation to obtain the ID of the whitelist template
parameters.help_zh: 白名单模板ID。可通过DescribeAllWhitelistTemplate获取
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group. For more information about resource groups, see Resource groups
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID。 关于资源组的更多信息，请参见什么是资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

Code.description_en:
The response code returned. Valid values:

200: success
400: client error
401: identity authentication failed
404: request page not found
500: server error
Code.description_zh:
响应码。各取值含义如下：
200：正常
400：客户端错误
401：身份验证失败
404：找不到请求页面
500：服务端错误

Status.description_en:
The status code returned. Valid values:

ok: The request is successful.
error: The request fails
Status.description_zh:
返回状态。各取值含义如下：
ok：正常返回
error：错误返回

HttpStatusCode.description_en:
The HTTP status code returned. Valid values:

200: success
400: client error
500: server error
HttpStatusCode.description_zh:
Http状态码。各取值含义如下：
200：正常
400：客户端错误
500：服务端错误

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:

true
false
Success.description_zh:
表示请求是否成功，各取值含义如下：

true：成功
false：失败
